note: boss phase 2: heavier, faster, more intense than phase 1
note_evidence: The track relies on an upbeat brass melody and standard funk percussion, lacking the heavy distortion, dark atmosphere, and menacing pressure expected for an enraged phase 2 boss.
beat_evidence: A crisp, syncopated Brazilian funk drum pattern establishes a highly tap-able and steady pulse right from 00:00.
loop_evidence: The track loses its momentum during a noticeable lull from 00:15 to 00:18 where the main beat drops out, breaking the continuous energy needed for a seamless boss loop.
